subject: Catalyst Health — Activation playbook & CS ownership
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@catalyst.health>, Devon Park <devon.park@catalyst.health>, procurement@catalyst.health
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Catalyst Health — Activation playbook & CS ownership

Hi team and Sarah —

Quick handoff from sales into CS and ops. Catalyst Health has signed a 12‑month Dedicated commitment (8x A100 equiv slots) with the following high‑level asks:

- Go‑live target: June 1, 2027 (6 weeks from now)
- Deployment: Dedicated (VPC peering), Okta SAML SSO, data retention 90 days (customer requires audit logs)
- Models: initial pin to "redwood-13b-opt-v2" with a fallback distil variant for lower latency routes
- Estimated steady state: 15–25 qps; peak burst to ~60 qps (short spikes)
- Compliance: SOC 2 evidence requested, procurement already circulated MSA

Attachments: Catalyst_SOW_v1.2.pdf (SOW with milestones), deployment_inventory.xlsx (customer infra inventory), Okta_SAML_metadata.xml

Requested next steps for CS/Implementation:
1) Assign CS owner and confirm owner-intro to customer (this week)
2) Provision sandbox API keys and onboarding tenant for Catalyst engineers
3) Schedule 60‑minute kickoff (engineering + security + product) during week of Apr 26
4) Validate hostnames/VPC peering checklist and share network CIDR requirements

Monica — given your bandwidth and experience with private deployments, can you take point? Karthik and Jordan will help on rollout docs and success criteria. Vivek — FYI on capacity reservation and any infra constraints.

Sarah / Devon — CC'ing you so Monica can introduce herself and coordinate kickoff logistics and any outstanding procurement items.

Thanks,
Chloe
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Catalyst_SOW_v1.2.pdf (pdf, 480KB)]
[Attachment: deployment_inventory.xlsx (xlsx, 64KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@catalyst.health>, Devon Park <devon.park@catalyst.health>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Health — Activation playbook & CS ownership

Thanks Chloe — happy to take this on.

I will:
- Introduce myself to Catalyst and share a kickoff agenda by EOD tomorrow
- Request sandbox credentials + test dataset access from Catalyst (Devon: can you drop the sample export to us?)
- Book a kickoff for Tue Apr 27 or Wed Apr 28 (please confirm availability) — target attendees: Catalyst eng lead, security lead, our infra eng, and product PM
- Draft success criteria aligned to SOW milestones: 1) network up, 2) sample workload validated, 3) secure SSO configured, 4) production cutover plan approved

Immediate asks for sales/infra:
- @Karthik: can you share the standard onboarding eval prompt set you use for clinical‑adjacent customers?
- @Jordan: please confirm whether we need to pre‑reserve the 8 GPU slots or if burst capacity will suffice for the first 30 days
- @Vivek: ping on infra availability (low risk, but want to confirm earliest alloc date)

I’ll mark this as owner = monica_patel and will own the weekly status until cutover.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@catalyst.health>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@catalyst.health>, procurement@catalyst.health
Date: 2027-04-20T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Health — Activation playbook & CS ownership

Monica — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks Chloe.

We can do Tue Apr 27 between 10–12 PT or Wed Apr 28 after 1pm PT. Devon will attach the limited sample export and our Okta metadata here. Procurement has routed the signed MSA (see attached signed_MSA.pdf) and they confirmed billing contact is billing@catalyst.health.

Two quick notes from our side:
- We will need explicit audit log export for the 90‑day retention requirement and a contact for security attestation calls.
- Our initial workload will include PII redaction and a small reranking pipeline; expect some custom evals in week 1.

Attachments: signed_MSA.pdf (pdf, 120KB), Okta_SAML_metadata.xml

—Sarah
Director of Engineering
Catalyst Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Health — Activation playbook & CS ownership

Quick ops note:
- For this size of commitment I recommend reserving the 8 slots for the first 60 days rather than relying on burst — reduces cold failures during the initial cutover and gives us stable perf baselines.
- Also propose we pin their model to a fixed revision (redwood-13b-opt-v2@rev-202704) for rollout so we can test regressions during canary.

Vivek — can you confirm whether we have capacity to honor a 5/10 reservation request? If not, propose we spin a temporary hosted pool for their pre‑prod tests.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Health — Activation playbook & CS ownership

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 09:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick ops note:
> - For this size of commitment I recommend reserving the 8 slots for the first 60 days rather than relying on burst — reduces cold failures during the initial cutover and gives us stable perf baselines.
> - Also propose we pin their model to a fixed revision (redwood-13b-opt-v2@rev-202704) for rollout so we can test regressions during canary.

I can confirm: earliest guaranteed allocation for dedicated GPUs is 2027-05-10 due to nearby renewals. We can:
- Reserve the 8 slots starting 2027‑05‑10 and prioritize their preprod windows the week prior on hosted capacity (we’ll provide a transient hosted pool with identical kernel config).
- We will support model pinning and maintain a canary plan (will add rollout steps to the Confluence doc).
- Security attestation: I’ll join the first security call and can surface any infra exceptions.

Link to infra plan (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/CH-Activation-Playbook

If Catalyst wants an earlier hard date, we can discuss a short‑term capacity bump (cost + procurement approval). Otherwise Monica, we’re set to support the June 1 target with the above plan.

—Vivek
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
